findings.name: the shipped panel has no enrollment approval screen and does not show the device-key fingerprint
findings.detail: GET /api/ops/nodes/enroll returns pubKeyFingerprint and pubKeyShort. public/app.js renders the TLS certificate fingerprint only. node-agent/enroll.js and the Connect computer screen are not in this tree.

findings.name: a captured signed pull is accepted again inside 120 seconds
findings.detail: first nj_4afb517c704ff406, replay nj_cbc22819a768bb5a. authNode still uses ±120s and no nonce (lib/ops/nodes.js). ±121s is 401.

findings.name: an enrolled node can rotate its token without the owner flag
findings.detail: POST /api/nodes/rotate called rotateToken while rotatePending was false. The old bearer then got 401 and the new bearer got 200.

findings.name: the owner can still mint a bearer-only 0.2.0 node
findings.detail: registerNode stores no devicePubKey. authNode accepts the bearer with a null signature. The HTTP route now also requires the owner password and the word ВЫДАТЬ, and the id must end in -test.

findings.name: per-IP counters stay in memory and a front on 127.0.0.1 still shares one bucket
findings.detail: X-Forwarded-For is ignored. Two different remoteAddress values get two buckets. The documented listener binds the Tailscale address, so a direct peer is its own bucket. tailscale serve to 127.0.0.1 would collapse peers again. Docs say not to use serve.

findings.name: two processes on one state file can each hand out a token
findings.detail: Both status() calls returned a different token. nodes.json kept one tokenHash. state.js writes with a temp file and rename and has no lock.

findings.name: a correct bearer token is slower than a wrong one
findings.detail: About 38.8× over 200 calls. timingSafeEqual runs on the SHA-256 of the bearer; Ed25519 verify runs only after that hash matches.

findings.name: no nonce store was added in the port
